pieces.Text: Dark Folk are skilled in the use of poison and never risk accidentally poisoning themselves. Dark Folk favor a foul-smelling black paste distilled from certain deep-underground fungi known as black smear-- injury; save Fort DC 15; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Str; cure 1 save.
